title: PCR from conceptual amplification loop to thermostable automated molecular platform
pressure: Molecular biology often needed one DNA sequence from tiny quantities against large backgrounds; cloning-based amplification was slow and labor intensive.
preExistingWorldModel: DNA polymerases, oligonucleotides and thermal denaturation were known, but repeated exponential target amplification was not a routine platform.
observationsAndInstruments: Mullis conceived repeated primer-directed amplification and early experiments demonstrated the loop.
Initial PCR required manual cycling and heat-labile polymerase replenishment.
Thermostable polymerase and programmed thermocyclers made many cycles routine.
PCR diffused into cloning, diagnostics, sequencing and forensics.
decisiveTests: remain robust through repeated thermal cycles
control contamination and primer specificity for high-stakes use
technicalOrScientificTransition: PCR became an instrument-like molecular platform only when thermostable enzyme, cycling automation and contamination/specificity practice joined the amplification concept.
rivalsAndFailures: The conceptual loop preceded the practical automated platform.
Manual early success did not predict throughput without enzyme/automation complements.
diffusionAndScaling: Diffusion depended on complements, cost/yield/standards and institutional adoption; the nominal breakthrough date did not equal broad effective use.
standardsAndInstitutions: Laboratories, firms, standard bodies, regulators, users and infrastructure operators owned different parts of evidence, implementation and consequence.
externalitiesAndCorrections: Lifecycle harms and authority changes are preserved where evidenced rather than inferred from local technical success.
secondOrderEffects: PCR became an instrument-like molecular platform only when thermostable enzyme, cycling automation and contamination/specificity practice joined the amplification concept.
sourceNativeSummary: PCR became an instrument-like molecular platform only when thermostable enzyme, cycling automation and contamination/specificity practice joined the amplification concept.
unresolvedHistoricalQuestions: Which complement most constrained diffusion at each lifecycle phase?
Which later narrative compresses materially distributed work?
